headline: Public hearing on an 85-unit apartment project at 85 Hunt Street, plus a zone change request for 319 Hunt Street.
summary: Olneyville Housing Corp. asks for approval to build 85 apartments at 85 Hunt Street, with about 40 percent affordable. A proposed zone change from R-3 to C-2 at 319 Hunt Street will get a discussion and possible vote on a recommendation to the City Council.
items: Update on the withdrawal of Application PZB-2026-09Z, a zoning relief request at 319 Hunt Street (AP 3, Lot 121)
Discussion and possible vote on recommending a zone change from R-3 to C-2 at 319 Hunt Street (AP 3, Lot 121) to the City Council, requested by EFFUAHSON LLC

Public hearing on 85 apartment units at 85 Hunt Street (AP 2, Lot 196) under Application PZB-2026-12UDR, requested by Olneyville Housing Corp. (d/b/a One Neighborhood Builders), with possible votes on master plan approval, dimensional variances, and waivers
Presentation from Weston & Sampson on a Transport Oriented District (TOD) plan
location: The Bessette Building (DPW) – 1280 High Street, Central Falls, RI 02863
plain_text:
CITY OF CENTRAL FALLS 
                 COMBINED PLANNING AND ZONING BOARD 
 
 
Page 1 of 2 
REGULAR MEETING 
(PUBLIC HEARING) 
Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
The Bessette Building (DPW) – 1280 High Street, Central Falls, RI 02863 
 
AGENDA 
I. Call to Order 
II. Roll Call 
III. Pledge of Allegiance 
IV. Approval of Minutes 
A. Special Meeting Minutes of August 26, 2026  
B. Regular Meeting Minutes of September 23, 2026 
C. Special Meeting Minutes of October 7, 2026 
V. Old Business 
A. Update regarding the withdrawal of Application PZB-2026-09Z: Request for Zoning Relief at 319 
Hunt Street (AP 3, Lot 121). 
VI. New Business 
A. Pursuant to its local and statutory authority as the Planning Board : Discussion and possible vote  
      to make a recommendation to the City Council regarding the application submitted by EFFUAHSON  
      LLC, of 40 Toronto Avenue, Providence, RI , for its proposed  zone change from R -3 to C -2 for th e 
      property located at 319 Hunt Street (AP 3, Lot 121). 
B.  Pursuant to its local and statutory authority as the Planning Board: Public hearing,  discussion, and 
       possible votes on approval for re-use development in OMUSOD and MBRD  zoning overlays, Master 
       Plan Approval, Dimensional Variances, and Waivers for Application PZB-2026-12UDR: 
       The Applicant, Olneyville Housing Corp. (d/b/a One Neighborhood Builders), of 66 Chaffee Street,  
       Providence, RI, is requesting Master Plan Approval and Dimensional Variances, pursuant to Unified  
       Development Review, to develop eighty -five (85) apartment units  at 85 Hunt Street (AP 2, Lot 196).  
       Approximately forty percent (40%) of units are proposed as affordable housing for households  
       earning up to eighty  percent (80%) of Area Median Income and sixty percent (60%) of units are  
       proposed as workforce and  market-rate units. In addition to the residential units, the Applicant is  
       proposing one commercial building of approximately 2,580 square feet in addition to approximately 
       16,000 square feet of retail space located on the ground floor of the buildings hosting the residential 
       units.  
C.  Presentation from Weston  & Sampson regarding the development of a Transport Oriented District  
       (TOD) plan. 
VII. Adjournment
Page 2 of 2
